static_verifiable.content: 1. Figure 1: Oversight as a hierarchy of entailment games. The root overseer delegates disputed sub-claims to specialized verifiers (factual, logical, policy), which may invoke primitive checks (retrieval/NLI, tests/static analysis, policy rules). A cost-aware routing policy selects verifiers under a budget B; leaf results propagate upward to resolve the root query.
static_verifiable.reason: The code directly implements the described hierarchy. hdo_system.py implements the root overseer; verifiers.py implements distinct factual (retrieval+NLI), logic (consistency/tests), and rules (policy regex) verifiers; routing.py implements the cost-aware selection policy (V* = argmax Delta_u/c); aggregation.py implements upward propagation of leaf results. The architecture in code maps exactly to the paper's Figure 1 description.
